title: Settings section in Angular: schedule, update policy, models reload, devices and pairing
goal: Settings (schedule, update policy, model reload, paired devices, pairing codes) works in the workspace with the same validation and results as live.js
acceptance: Settings draft, /api/settings/schedule, /api/update/policy and /api/models/reload behave as live.js, including the restart wait
Devices list, revoke and pairing codes (/api/devices, /api/device/codes) match live.js; a test across the handlers and the component
The old Settings panel links to the new one
privacy: Neutral invented sorties, devices and names only; tokens and pairing codes never in tests or logs.
escalation: A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: the largest form in live.js (settingsModel, readSettingsDraft, renderDevices, pairingHtml). Not a measurement.
